supports: Safe buffer zones around every Jewish school and synagogue
positions.quote: I would establish safe buffer zones around every Jewish school and synagogue now.

source.title: Saritha Komatireddy’s Statement on Endorsing Safe Buffer Zones (campaign site)

positions.impact: Protests near Jewish schools and synagogues could face stricter distance limits, enforced by the Attorney General's office. She cites a buffer zone law already on New York's books.

positions.quote: We don’t need a tax hike.

source.title: Remarks on Homeowners’ Tax, March 30, 2026 (campaign site)

positions.impact: She would publicly oppose new taxes on homeowners. The Attorney General doesn't set taxes, so this is an advocacy position rather than something the office decides.
